authority.label: Staff-domain meaning proposal; specialist review required

records.label: Capital
records.scope: Frozen-source staff-question research. Source text is not current-law assurance and proposed meaning is not an official interpretation. Concept role: dwp:AssessmentInput.
records.text: Actual and notional capital, ownership, valuation and disregards precede any deemed-income assessment. Savings is not a complete capital definition.

records.label: Chapter 84 scope and decision sequence
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: Scope and sequence for deciding Pension Credit capital and deemed weekly income: classify the resource, establish ownership, apply disregards, value capital, test notional capital and calculate deemed weekly income.

records.label: What counts as capital
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: Meaning of capital for Pension Credit, including money, lump sums, investments, property and beneficial interests; distinguishes capital from defined income and routes the point at which income becomes capital.

records.label: Beneficial and legal ownership of capital
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: When capital counts for a person: beneficial and legal ownership, joint interests, capital held on trust and who may withdraw or sell it.

records.label: Framework for deciding whether capital is disregarded
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: Framework for deciding whether capital is disregarded, who must supply evidence, whether the disregard affects income or deemed income, and the available disregard periods.

records.label: Premises occupied by a partner or relative
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: When premises occupied by an older or incapacitated relative, or a non-estranged former partner, are disregarded indefinitely; includes the close-relative route, indicators of incapacity and the test for separately saleable parts.

records.label: Valuing capital in the UK, outside the UK and in joint ownership
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: How to value non-disregarded capital in and outside the UK and jointly held capital, including sale-cost and secured-debt deductions, ownership forms and worked examples.

records.label: Notional capital and the general deprivation rule
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: When a person is treated as having notional capital, the main deprivation exceptions, whose acts count and why deprivation must be decided again for each claim.

records.label: Significant purpose and evidence for deprivation
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: How to decide whether obtaining Pension Credit or more Pension Credit was a significant purpose of deprivation, including the evidence burden, mental capacity, choice and knowledge.

records.label: Further factors bearing on the purpose of deprivation
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: Further deprivation-purpose factors: reliance on departmental advice, timing, means after disposal and why foreseeable need for Pension Credit alone is insufficient.

records.label: Calculating deemed weekly income from capital
records.scope: Bounded discovery topic; not legal applicability.
records.text: Pension Credit deemed weekly income formula and calculation inputs, including aggregation, when income becomes capital, withdrawals, downstream treatment and the Appendix 1 table.
